chunks: Other than the chosen ones among them.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Mukhlasin (chosen ones) in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Mukhlasin' are often identified with the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, representing the pinnacle of spiritual purity and divine election. This verse highlights their unique status as the sole recipients of God's mercy, distinguishing them from the broader creation who may be subject to divine punishment or general blessings.
